object.description: Setup: build with a map key, device traffic through a capturing proxy, fresh install. Steps: 1. Open every bottom navigation tab. 2. Record and finish a 2 min session, open Summary and History and export a workout. 3. List the destination hosts and request contents. 4. Read the dependencies in the build file for crash-reporting and analytics libraries. Expected: All requests go to the map provider for styles or tiles, and 0 requests carry workout data, heart rate data or logs. Map tile coordinates are the only location information sent. The build has 0 crash-reporting or analytics libraries.
